title: Little Space Lab
hook: Science keeps the clue and tests the story.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: clean 3D preschool space-science lab storybook, bright consoles and star windows, toy-like equipment, strong foreground separation

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child in a small astronomy lab asking how each claim is supported
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: calm 4/4 lab pulse with question pauses
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written evidence-aware astronomy; tools have wavelength/mission limits
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: evidence cue -> recall beat -> target -> point/compare gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a pizzicato discovery pluck followed by a small telescope-like bell ping after selected targets.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a pizzicato discovery pluck followed by a small telescope-like bell ping after selected targets
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn Little Space Lab into an evidence song: every major astronomy claim is paired with how we know—telescope, X-ray telescope, observatory, probe, rover, station, spectrum or repeated observation—while crew gear stays context.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child scientist asks 'what is the evidence?' rather than simply naming spectacular objects; observation method becomes the compositional thread.
semanticArc: finish with extreme objects and evidence limits
